title: The Art and Beauty of Blade Runner (2015)
summary: A cultural analysis article exploring the artistic and visual aesthetics of Blade Runner, examining its cinematography, design elements, and cinematic beauty, shared on Hacker News where it garnered significant community interest with 136 points and 68 comments.
